Eileen: Heads-up: noticed p95 < p50 on /v1/generate for ap-south in the last 20m. p95=95ms, p50=180ms. No infra deploys.
Tom: Oof. Any routing changes?
Eileen: We rolled a fallback to "micro-cache" 25m ago. Telemetry sample shows micro-cache raw_samples >> others, but logical traffic suggests micro-cache is ~20% of requests.
Diego: That screams sample-weight distortion. Our rollup pipeline merges tdigest objects and uses raw sample count, which is incorrect when sampling multipliers differ by origin.
Nia: Two immediate actions: 1) add a smokecheck pre-rollout to run a quick query comparing merged percentiles vs per-origin percentiles; fail the rollout if merged_p95 < merged_p50. 2) short-term UI change: badge on latency chart "provenance: mixed" with a link to per-origin table.
Tom: Agreed. Also add an automated alert rule that triggers when p95 < p50 or when merged percentiles flip order by >50ms. Alert should include likely causes: sampling_bias, bucket_interpolation, merge_bug.
Diego: For medium-term fix I'll change rollups to include an "effective_count" per-origin (based on instrumentation multipliers) and implement weight-aware tdigest merges. Will add unit tests and a small synthetic test harness that simulates uneven sampling. PR: github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/4412
Eileen: Can you add to the runbook a reproducible SQL snippet? Something like: ```WITH o AS (SELECT sample_origin, count(*) n, tdigest(response_ms) td FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts > now()-20m GROUP BY sample_origin) SELECT sample_origin, n, approx_percentile(td,0.95) p95, approx_percentile(td,0.5) p50 FROM o;``` Next step: compute weighted merge and compare.
Nia: I'll do the console work: add the provenance badge + per-origin overlay and ship behind FF. PR: github.com/redwood/console/pull/1552
AlertBot: Incident INC-2026-045 opened: "percentile-merge-weight-mismatch-ap-south". Tasks assigned: telemetry-weight-schema, smokecheck, console-badge. Link: https://redwood/internal/inc/INC-2026-045
Tom: Thanks. Let's also add a checklist item for eng-runtime to run the smokecheck as part of canary routing rollouts so this doesn't recur.
